description: Use when the user wants to open or download a public document found with search_exploration_reports. Read-only: give the hit's corpus and doc_key; returns the document's title and series and temporary download links to its files (it changes nothing). 'wamex': the report's original PDF, appendix ZIPs and an OCR'd copy; 'sarig': the report PDF with its abstract, tenements, holder and year; 'ebookshop': the publication's PDF; 'hylogger': the report PDF with its hole, State and NVCL dataset id; 'geolit': the paper's PDF with its journal and year, except for papers licensed for text mining only, which have no file to share.

corpus.description: Which corpus the key belongs to.

doc_key.description: The hit's doc_key: a WAMEX anumber ('A12345'), a GSWA product code ('N19EB'), a geolit sha256, or a hylogger '<dataset id>.sp' key, or a sarig key ('env02577').

name: document_files
title: List a document's files
